ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to scattered point sources and dense peripheral clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white and ochre clusters at the extreme distal tips (coordinates 0,400 to 100,200 relative). Scattered white point-blobs (likely water droplets or minor scarring) distributed non-uniformly across the central and inner-trailing surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending inward to a depth of roughly 12% of the vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with approximately 12-14 distinct pixel peaks per lobe. Higher amplitude serrations located closer to the median notch, transitioning to finer, more frequent variations toward the mid-lobe before smoothing near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve originating from the median notch, extending laterally with a gradual upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated, irregular high-contrast clusters at the outer tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization. Sparse white point-clusters (rosette-like) visible on the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting textured irregular growth at the extreme outer edges of both lobes.
